items.detail: October WASDE raised corn yield to 181.2 bpa (trade expected a cut to ~177.6), pushing ending stocks to 1.849B bu (+282M) — Dec corn fell 4% to $4.80½, its lowest close since Aug 13, on forced liquidation of a 377,850-contract fund net-long. Energy cut the other way: Hurricane Isaias shut 71.5% of Gulf oil production (1.46M bpd), VLCC rates hit a record above $1.4M/day, and Brent closed at $104.72 — up, after falling on Iran de-escalation headlines and the Russian diesel license through April 7, 2027. Friday's tape priced physical disruption over political talk. Futures reopen Sunday evening — gap risk runs in both directions.
